option_relations.rationale: SARS-CoV-2–associated optic neuritis is a specific type of optic neuritis
Immune-mediated parainfectious optic neuritis could be related to optic neuritis, but the connection is less direct
COVID-19-associated optic neuritis and retinal vasculitis is a broader condition that includes optic neuritis
Inflammation-induced ocular neuropathy associated with SARS-CoV-2–induced panuveitis is related to optic neuritis, but the connection is less direct
